description: Clone an existing ad (same creative) into other ad squads. New ads are created PAUSED. Skips squads that already have an ad with that creative. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

new_name.description: Name for the new ads; defaults to the source ad name

name: snap_clone_ad
